modelingNotes: Manufacturer spelling GV2P06; source GV2-P06 retained as required catalog identity. Hyphen interpreted as presentation separator using exact code, operator and adjustment-range agreement.

OFF/open reference state. Poles share mechanical operation and tripping, but never permanent electrical continuity. Protection dynamics are not simulated.
